title: Extension SW lacks page context → MAIN world fetch
trigger: MV3 service worker fetch tới cookie/origin-gated site trả 403/401 trong khi fetch từ page DevTools thành công.
principle: MV3 service worker fetch() chạy trong extension origin (chrome-extension://...), KHÔNG có page context (site cookies, origin header, referer). Site yêu cầu cookies + origin (YouTube, Google, login-gated) → SW fetch 403/401. MAIN world content script ("world": "MAIN") chạy trong page origin → có đầy đủ cookies + origin → fetch thành công. Khi SW fetch bị 403 do thiếu page context, chuyển fetch sang MAIN world script, relay kết quả về SW qua window.postMessage → ISOLATED content-script → chrome.runtime.sendMessage.

cases.context: Background service worker fetch InnerTube API trả 403 — SW không có YouTube cookies (SAPISID, HSID) và không có page origin header
Alternative: dùng chrome.cookies.getAll() + manual cookie header — works nhưng thiếu origin/referer, MAIN world sạch hơn khi page context available
cases.good:
// MAIN world: browser sends cookies + origin + referer automatically, no manual assembly
// Only use chrome.cookies.getAll() when page context is NOT available (no matching tab open)

applyFor: Chrome MV3 extension fetch tới cookie/origin-gated sites (YouTube, Google, login-gated)
Any SW fetch returning 403 where the page itself can fetch successfully (diagnose: page DevTools fetch works, SW fetch 403s)
Cross-origin requests needing session cookies (SAPISID, HSID, session cookies)
SW fetch fails but page-context fetch succeeds — move fetch to MAIN world content script, relay result back via postMessage → ISOLATED → chrome.runtime.sendMessage
